dossiers.name: Rescue baton
dossiers.tagline: The tool that keeps a door open
summary: A dark ceramic evacuation baton issued to Nacre's service crews.
Supplied description preserved. Additional item details are proposed.
Profile, turnaround reference and continuity ledger.

supplied_canon.text: Telescoping rescue baton with a dark ceramic exterior and a worn grip, carried by Moki Vey. These details are protected.

proposed_additions.text: All maker names, numbers, events and ledger entries below are invented proposals for review.

name.text: Rescue baton. Crews call it a door-key; manifests list it as Evacuation Tool E-7.

item_type.text: Non-lethal evacuation tool, issued equipment of the Nacre service crews.

purpose.text: Holding open jammed hatches, breaking safety glass and keeping space around a rescue.

one_line.text: A scuffed black baton that has opened more doors than it has struck people.

status_now.text: Clipped to Moki Vey's belt at the opening of 2189; its lock is stiff and needs cleaning.

significance.text: It shows Moki still thinks like an evacuation worker; drawing it means he has run out of ordinary options.

record_controls.text: AR-001 / revision 1 / effective story time: opening of 2189. Supplied description protected.

overall_look.text: A short matte-black cylinder with three telescoping segments and a rubbered grip worn pale at the thumb.

size_weight.text: Closed 21 cm (8.3 in); extended 60 cm (23.6 in); weight 640 g (1.4 lb).

shape.text: Straight, slightly tapered segments ending in a blunt ceramic cap; no blade, hook or point.

materials.text: Ceramic-composite outer shells over a steel spring lock; nitrile grip sleeve.

colours.text: Charcoal black with a faded orange crew band below the grip.

markings.text: Stencilled E-7 and a scratched-out crew number; a hairline crack repaired with resin near the cap.

sound_smell.text: Locks with a hard double click; smells faintly of machine oil and salt.

condition.text: Worn but sound; the second segment drags when wet.

visual_anchors.text: Matte charcoal segments, faded orange band, worn pale grip, blunt ceramic cap. Always clipped at Moki's right hip.

origin.text: Made in Nacre's municipal workshops for the service crews.

made_when.text: Made in 2181 on the Eastern service deck.

made_how.text: Pressed ceramic shells around a standard steel lock; crews fit their own grips.

previous_owners.text: Issued new to Moki Vey / CH-001 in 2181; no earlier owner.

key_events.text: Used to brace a stalled transit-deck hatch during the 2183 evacuation; cracked against a coolant valve in the 2186 accident.

legends.text: Crews joke that an E-7 is worth more than a supervisor's word.

how_acquired.text: Issued by his old evacuation crew; he kept it legally when he left corporate employment.

provenance_gaps.text: Nobody logged the 2186 crack; the company record says the tool was returned.

abilities.text: None: an ordinary tool. Its value is reach, a hard cap for glass and a lock that holds a hatch open.

how_it_works.text: A spring lock fixes each extended segment; a twist releases it.

activation.text: Snapped open with a flick; closed by twisting the grip and pressing the cap.

limits.text: Holds a hatch against up to 80 kg of load; extends to 60 cm at most.

costs.text: Occupies one hand and slows climbing.

weaknesses.text: Limited reach; saltwater can jam the lock; useless against a ranged threat.

side_effects.text: Carrying it makes checkpoint guards more suspicious.

cannot_do.text: No electric charge, no blade, no projectile and no hidden lethal mode.

linked_system.text: Not applicable: it runs on no magic system.

who_can_use.text: Anyone with two hands; crews train with it.

skill_needed.text: Crew drills: opening, bracing and glass-breaking.

handling.text: Clipped closed at the right hip; drawn with the right hand.

combat_use.text: A last resort to keep space around a rescue; a character beat, never a duel.

everyday_use.text: Bracing access panels while he works.

maintenance.text: He checks its lock after every use and wipes salt from the segments.

damage.text: Repeated saltwater use jams the lock; a crushed segment must be replaced.

legal.text: Legal for registered service workers; questioned at corporate checkpoints.

signature_use.text: He taps it twice against a hatch before trusting it.

allowed_users.text: Moki Vey / CH-001; Tavi Rook / CH-004 in an emergency.

forbidden_users.text: Director Oren Sael / CH-005 and his security staff must never take it.

who_wants_it.text: Sael's security wants it as evidence of unauthorised repair work.

transfers.text: Opening: Moki. Setback: seized with the workshop. Climax: back in Moki's hands.

bond.text: It is the last piece of his crew years he trusts.

value.text: About forty credits new; worthless to anyone but a crew worker.

first_appearance.text: Chapter 1, clipped to his belt while he repairs an intake.

introduction.text: Seen before it is named: a click at his hip as he crouches.

key_scenes.text: The intake failure; the seized workshop; the climax shutdown.

turning_point.text: Its seizure at the setback leaves Moki without his oldest tool.

final_state.text: Clipped back on his belt, lock cleaned.

reveal_points.text: The 2186 crack is explained at the midpoint.

must_show_1.text: The double click when it locks open.

must_show_2.text: The resin-repaired crack near the cap.

must_show_3.text: Moki hands it to Tavi rather than holding the hatch himself.

location_ledger.text: Opening: Moki's belt. Setback: sealed workshop. Climax: Moki's belt.

condition_ledger.text: Lock drags when wet from the opening; no new damage unless the author adds it.

uses_ledger.text: One bracing use per scene at most; no combat use before the setback.

secrets_ledger.text: The crack proves he was at the 2186 valve; only Moki knows at the opening.

linked_records.text: CH-001 Moki Vey; CH-004 Tavi Rook; PL-001 Nacre.

unresolved_choices.text: The author may keep or drop the orange crew band.

artwork_note.text: Portrait and turnaround are simple reference drawings; replace them with Stable Diffusion or ChatGPT art.

verification_scope.text: Checked against the Moki Vey dossier; manuscript check pending.

dossiers.name: Nacre
dossiers.tagline: A city built on borrowed time
summary: A vertical coastal city of pumps, decks and salt.
Supplied description preserved. Additional place details are proposed.
Profile, mood views and continuity ledger.

supplied_canon.text: Vertical coastal city in the year 2189, built in stacked decks above a cold sea. These details are protected.

proposed_additions.text: All districts, numbers, factions and events below are invented proposals for review.

name.text: Nacre. Dockers say the Stack; the company calls it Nacre Municipal Platform.

place_type.text: A vertical city of stacked residential, industrial and service decks.

one_line.text: A tower-city that drinks the sea through pumps nobody upstairs ever sees.

role_in_story.text: Home, workplace and battleground: whoever controls its pumps controls its people.

first_impression.text: Wet light, steel stairs, waterfalls of runoff between the decks.

record_controls.text: PL-001 / revision 1 / effective story time: opening of 2189.

location.text: On a basalt shelf two kilometres off the mainland, joined by one rail causeway.

size_scale.text: About 1.2 km tall in 40 decks; roughly 310,000 residents.

layout.text: Corporate offices on decks 30-40, homes on decks 8-29, service decks and pump halls on decks 1-7.

landmarks.text: The Spillway, a curtain of runoff down the east face; the Intake Halls at sea level.

districts.text: Lower service decks; the Mid-Stack markets; the Crown, where the company sits.

terrain.text: Cold, wet, windy; fog most mornings, storms in autumn.

architecture.text: Grey composite, steel gantries, patched pipes; newer glass only near the Crown.

map_notes.text: The causeway enters on deck 4 from the west; the Intake Halls face east.

sights.text: Lit gantries, rust streaks, teal safety lamps on the service decks.

sounds.text: Pump thrum through every wall; gulls; the hiss of runoff.

smells.text: Salt, hot oil and wet concrete.

touch.text: Cold rails, damp air, warm pipes you learn not to lean on.

light.text: Grey daylight above deck 20; amber work lights and teal lamps below.

seasons.text: A short summer of clear days; long foggy winters.

signature_detail.text: A pump thrum you feel in your teeth.

founding.text: Founded in 2091 as a desalination platform; residents came later.

eras.text: Platform era (2091-2120); Stack era (2120-2170); company era (2170 onward).

key_events.text: The 2186 coolant accident on the Eastern service deck, officially a worker's negligence.

ruins.text: Sealed first-generation pump rooms under deck 1.

recent_change.text: The company is planning a citywide restart of the water system.

myths.text: Old crews say the first pumps still run behind the sealed doors.

timeline_facts.text: Founded 2091; 40 decks; about 310,000 residents in 2189; accident 2186.

population.text: Service families on the low decks; clerks and traders mid-Stack; company staff at the Crown.

factions.text: The company (Director Oren Sael / CH-005); neighbourhood repair crews; the water analysts.

rulers.text: Director Oren Sael / CH-005 controls infrastructure access, which is power in Nacre.

culture.text: Outage rituals: neighbours share stored water and keep a light at every stairwell.

language.text: Nacre Dock Cant on the service decks: head pressure, drift, clearance.

notable_people.text: Moki Vey / CH-001; Imani Vey / CH-002; Tavi Rook / CH-004.

outsiders.text: Welcomed if they can fix something; distrusted if they carry company passes.

laws.text: Unlicensed work on the water system is forbidden.

dangers.text: Failing pumps, flooded service decks, company security.

hazards.text: Storm surge up to deck 3; slick gantries.

forbidden.text: The sealed pump rooms under deck 1.

magic_here.text: MG-001 Biofilament mutation: only the trial survivors carry it.

access.text: The rail causeway on deck 4, the ferry quays at sea level.

routes.text: Inside the Stack: lifts, stairwells and service ladders.

travel_times.text: Deck 6 to the Intake Halls: eight minutes on foot; deck 6 to the Crown: twenty minutes by lift.

hidden_ways.text: Old maintenance crawlways between decks 2 and 7.

transport.text: Freight lifts, a slow passenger lift, the causeway train.

borders.text: Checkpoints at deck 30 and at the causeway gate.

first_appearance.text: Chapter 1, the Intake Halls at dawn.

scenes_set_here.text: Every scene of the first arc.

how_it_changes.text: From a city that hides its pumps to one that watches them.

characters_here.text: Moki Vey / CH-001 was born here on the lower decks.

reveal_points.text: The sealed pump rooms are part of the trial at the midpoint.

must_show_1.text: The pump thrum felt through walls.

must_show_3.text: Neighbours sharing water during an outage.

fixed_anchors.text: Stacked grey decks, gantries, teal service lamps, a curtain of runoff on the east face.

state_ledger.text: Opening: eastern intake failing. Climax: restart halted.

occupancy_ledger.text: Moki works on deck 6; Imani's lab is on deck 12.

secrets_ledger.text: The trial ran in the Intake Halls; Sael and a small circle know.

linked_records.text: CH-001 Moki Vey; AR-001 rescue baton; MG-001 Biofilament mutation.

unresolved_choices.text: The author may rename districts or change the number of decks.

artwork_note.text: Establishing shot and mood views are simple reference drawings; replace them with Stable Diffusion or ChatGPT art.

verification_scope.text: Checked against the Moki Vey dossier; manuscript check pending.

dossiers.name: Biofilament mutation
summary: A non-magical acquired mutation from an illegal coolant trial.
Supplied rules preserved. Additional system details are proposed.
Profile, sigil, in-use study and use ledger.

supplied_canon.text: Non-magical acquired mutation: adaptive biofilaments from an experimental coolant reinforce tendons and sense vibration, always at a physical cost. These rules are protected.

proposed_additions.text: Numbers, names and history below are invented proposals for review.

name.text: Biofilament mutation. Survivors say the filaments; the company file says Trial 7 adverse effect.

kind_of_power.text: Invented science-fiction biology, not magic and not a real medical mechanism.

source.text: Adaptive biofilaments carried by an experimental coolant into damaged tissue.

nature.text: Living filaments that brace tendons and carry vibration to the nerves.

one_line.text: Borrowed strength that sends the bill as heat and tremor.

record_controls.text: MG-001 / revision 1 / effective story time: opening of 2189.

who_has_it.text: Only people exposed in the 2186 coolant trial, among them Moki Vey / CH-001.

how_gained.text: Exposure to the trial coolant through a wound; it cannot be learned.

activation.text: Intentional muscle recruitment and a controlled breath; panic triggers it unevenly.

cost.text: Each use brings heat, dehydration and loss of fine motor control.

recovery.text: At least twenty minutes of cooling and rest after the third burst; full recovery may take hours.

price_long.text: Ignored tremor can leave days of weakness; long-term effects are unknown.

rarity.text: Perhaps a dozen survivors in Nacre.

core_rules.text: Reinforcement and vibration sense only; every use costs heat and control.

hard_limits.text: Anchor lasts up to eight seconds per burst; three bursts within ten minutes at most.

range_duration.text: Touch range only; Resonance needs direct contact and several quiet seconds.

cannot_do.text: No electricity, no teleportation, no bullet resistance, no remote control, no healing.

counters.text: Heat, dehydration, sustained exertion; insulated gloves block Resonance.

exceptions.text: None: panic can trigger a burst, but it still counts against the three.

interactions.text: Coolant exposure can renew the filaments; strong machine vibration confuses Resonance.

practitioners.text: Moki Vey / CH-001; other survivors unknown at the opening.

training.text: Rehabilitation with Dr. Sera Noll / CH-003 taught pacing and warning signs.

ranks.text: None; only experience with the stop signals.

schools.text: None: it is a medical secret, not a tradition.

mastery.text: Knowing when to stop before the tremor starts.

named_power_1.text: Anchor: reinforces tendons for a brief brace or controlled lift. It cannot protect skin or bones.

named_power_2.text: Resonance: through direct touch, reads broad vibration changes in known machinery. It cannot read data or thoughts.

combinations.text: Resonance to find the failing part, then Anchor to hold it while someone else repairs it.

rituals.text: A controlled breath; water before and after.

visual_signs.text: Faint teal lines at the wrists brighten; graphite ridges along the forearms rise.

sounds_smells.text: No sound; skin smells of hot metal after a burst.

on_the_body.text: Fine raised graphite ridges on the outer forearms; teal wrist lines.

tells.text: A fine hand tremor before failure: a stop signal.

sigil.text: A teal ring crossed by three vertical filaments, the trial survivors' private mark.

failure_conditions.text: Fever, injury, dehydration, or a fourth burst inside ten minutes.

overuse.text: Heat and tremor that last into the next scene; no reset at a scene cut.

misuse.text: The company wants to make it repeatable in workers.

worst_case.text: Collapse at the wrong moment while holding a failing machine.

origin_story.text: Trial 7, an unauthorised coolant trial on Nacre's Eastern service deck.

discovery.text: Discovered in 2186 when the trial failed and exposed Moki Vey.

key_events.text: 2186 exposure; 2186-2188 rehabilitation; 2189 evidence of an ongoing programme.

lore.text: Survivors whisper that the filaments are learning; nobody knows.

lost_knowledge.text: Whether the filaments can safely be removed.

public_view.text: Most of Nacre has never heard of it.

law.text: Officially it does not exist; the trial was erased.

institutions.text: The company holds the trial records.

economy.text: None yet; the company sees a product.

first_use.text: Chapter 1, Anchor holds a failing intake housing.

key_uses.text: The intake repair; the evidence relay; the climax shutdown.

escalation.text: Each use costs more as the arc goes on; no new powers appear.

climax_use.text: Moki holds a failing actuator for one burst while Tavi completes the isolation.

reveal_points.text: Glow and tremor early; the trial's scope at the midpoint.

must_show_1.text: The tremor appears before a failure.

power_ledger.text: Count every Anchor burst per scene; three within ten minutes is the ceiling; no reset at a scene cut.

rules_ledger.text: Stated on the page so far: none (manuscript check pending).

secrets_ledger.text: The trial's scope: Sael and a small circle until the midpoint.

linked_records.text: CH-001 Moki Vey; CH-003 Dr. Sera Noll; PL-001 Nacre.

unresolved_choices.text: The author may change the colour of the signs.

artwork_note.text: The sigil is a simple reference drawing; make the in-use study in Akowe or upload your own.

verification_scope.text: Checked against the Moki Vey dossier; manuscript check pending.
